senses.gloss: † भृश् भृश्, i. 4, Par. To fall; cf. भ्रंश्.

भृश भृश (perhaps akin to भ्रंश्),
 I. adj., comparat. भ्रशीयंस्, superl. भ्रशिष्ठ, Much, exceeding.
 II. ˚शम्, adv.
 1. Much, Pañc. iii. d. 188.
 2. Exceedingly, violently, Pañc. iii. d. 183.
 3. Superiority, better.
 4. Repeatedly, often, Pañc. iii. d. 13.
 5. Beautifully.
 6. Quickly, Chr. 7, 13; 25, 15.
 7. In the beginning of comp. भृश-, e. g. Chr. 31, 16.
 --Comp.
भृशता भृश + ता, f. Violence, Ragh. 11, 58.

भृष्टि भृष्टि, f., i. e. भ्रज्ज् + ति,
 1. Frying.
 2. A lonely garden.
 --Comp.
